value.rationale: The zero-exponent survivor-only endpoint is a natural singular boundary of a current reinforced voting model. The result determines its whole-scale geometric fixation law with quantitative total-variation convergence, a fully constructive finite-state law and all fixed-order exponential corrections to its mean. These show an ordered sequence of genuine metastable support bottlenecks rather than an arbitrary finite invariant.
